changelog: Sync to YouTube Music history, Clear listening history and Restore now each use a distinct icon
Clear recent searches uses an icon matching the other Settings rows
The Played count is more resilient for signed-in accounts, falling back to locally tracked listens when account history is unavailable
Meoify no longer stays active in the background unless audio is playing or the app is in recent apps/foreground
A paused session stops the background service promptly instead of lingering in the notification shade
